correctness.rationale: Explicit finite determinization of all prescribed-label branches via nonempty sets of 7 legal suffix states yields 16 fully closed states. Direct right-language minimization yields the displayed 5-state DFA. Its 5 linear transfer equations prove the rational generating function, and h=(0,-3,-2,-6,-4) yields 5k<=2n+6. Constructive binary mask families attain every extremal k. All 16/5 transitions and direct traces through n=11 were checked by the delivered standalone script; no finite computation is substituted for the formal automaton construction.

Earlier independence-entropy results fix a filling outside the free coordinates. The published 000/111 coordinate result is not broader than the different forbidden pair 000/101.
